verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API with endpoints for analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts and labels, plus an MCP server that acts on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts. That covers a meaningful share of the product, but nothing claims or shows parity with the UI, and many UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API coverage of snoozing, assignment, canned responses, rules/automations, team chat and settings, an OpenAPI spec or other machine-readable full surface, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Complete reference for Missive API endpoints: analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels, and more
